planted_error_test: not part of the sampled verification; see scripts/run_system_tests.py, which plants predeclared wrong labels in a separate synthetic copy
role_independence: Separate GPT-6 Luna verifier prompt; the first-pass labels are never sent. Agreement on the gpt-6-luna stratum is a same-model test-retest, not independent accuracy.
sample_policy: deterministic SHA-256 ordering of review_id under the declared seed; target=min(completed,max(minimum,round(completed*fraction)),maximum when set)

sampling.design: distinct texts stratified by final label source; SHA-256(seed:review_id) order within stratum
sampling.weights: group_size x stratum population texts / stratum sample (row-weighted estimates)
